contentPattern.structure: left app photo (CSS background) | heading + subtitle + 2 store-badge links

suitableFor: photo beside heading/copy + app-store badge links on a colored panel

implementationNote: Block-based component (resourceType core/franklin/components/block/v1/block) modelled like hero-trust so the JCR converter preserves the variant class and the image-inside-link store badges. Replaces the earlier columns-app variant, which the md2jcr columns partial could not represent (dropped variant class + badge images). Left photo is a CSS background from the Admiral CDN.
